newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ifo head-June index shows German recovery moderate.
newsitem.headline: Ifo head-June index shows German recovery moderate.

text.p: The president of Germany's Ifo economic research institute said on Friday the rise in the Ifo June business climate index showed Germany's economic recovery was progressing, but only very moderately.
Karl-Heinrich Oppenlaender, speaking to reporters after the release of the June index, also said the results showed economic recovery in the east of Germany was still faltering.

Ifo's west German business climate index rose to 96.0 in June from 95.4 in May, according to data released earlier. But the index for business expectations fell slightly, giving a reading of 103.7 in June after 104.1 in May.
The index showed that "the economic recovery is progressing further, but in a very moderate way," Oppenlaender.
Oppenlaender also said it was important to note this drop in expectations.
"We are currently in a situation in which expectations should be improving," he told Reuters. But he said this would only be possible when investors and firms were more confident.
Instead, Oppenlaender said, the uncertainty in business circles and among investors was become more grave.
